sharedPrompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Create one finished commercial photograph for Prince George Towing's homepage. Input images 1–3 are identity references of the SAME real truck. Image 4 is the real company's logo, a reference for the navy and orange graphic identity only, NOT its phone number.
Preserve the exact truck: white Kenworth long-hood sleeper cab, burgundy wheel arches and angular burgundy hood stripe, burgundy lower cab stripe, white compartmented recovery body, burgundy conventional twin recovery boom, silver tubular A-frame, twin rear axles and single front axle (THREE axles total), silver cylindrical fuel tank, white/silver front brush guard, truck unit 568. Original side lettering: PRINCE in navy, GEORGE in orange-red, TOWING & RECOVERY, 778-281-0200. Use the exact P-and-hook brand mark where visible. The red armored-character decal on the sleeper stays small and in the same place if visible. Do not repaint the truck navy or orange. Do not invent extra axles, new vehicles in the fleet or giant rotator cranes. The logo reference's different phone number MUST NOT appear.
Art direction shared across the whole set: believable premium editorial photography, northern British Columbia spruce forests and practical roads/work yards, cool neutral whites and deep navy-toned natural shadows, warm amber highlights and real burgundy paint, gently directional late-afternoon light, rich but restrained contrast, fine material texture and mild grain. No hyper-glossy CGI, no orange/teal filter, no floating vehicles, no collage, no border, no overlay text, no watermark. Each image is one new illustrative marketing scene based on the real vehicle, not a reproduction of the source yard photo.
